bridgeErrorUnreachable.message: Can’t reach voyager serve on this port. Check that it’s running, then try again.

bridgeErrorRejected.message: That code didn’t work. Run voyager pair for a new one.

bridgeErrorUpgradeExtension.message: This voyager CLI needs a newer Voyager. Update the extension, then pair again.

bridgeErrorUpgradeCli.message: This Voyager needs a newer voyager CLI. Update the CLI, then pair again.

bridgeErrorNoResponse.message: Voyager didn’t answer. Reopen this popup to see whether pairing finished.

bridgeErrorGeneric.message: That didn’t work. Run voyager pair for a new code and try again.

chatgptProUsageWeeklyLimitHint.message: Leave at 0 to set it automatically: the limit ChatGPT reports when it reports one, otherwise your plan's usual allowance (Pro Lite 50; Pro 200, 100 from 30 October 2026). Pro Max has no default. Any other number is used instead, until ChatGPT reports its own limit.

export_read_incomplete.message: This export may be incomplete. The beginning, end, or message order could not be confirmed.

export_read_interrupted.message: Export stopped because the conversation changed or a response started. Wait for the response to finish, then try again.

export_read_history_unavailable.message: Couldn't read the full conversation history. Scroll up to load earlier messages, then try again.
